title: Slow Hours Oversized Tee — Black
description: Made for the slow hours — late light, low rooms, conversation that doesn't need to be loud. Slightly oversized cut with a clean dropped shoulder; heavyweight cotton with a premium hand-feel, substantial enough to lean into. Designed in deep black to pair with washed denim, cargos, or stacked black-on-black. One of the pieces the JONO Set reaches for when the evening matters but the look shouldn't try too hard. 30-day returns at shopjono.com — lock your size before the black sells through.

title: Quiet Edge Oversized Tee — Black
description: Built for the moments between — when the day's noise hasn't started and the mind has space. A true oversized cut with relaxed shoulders; heavyweight cotton with structured drape. In deep black for restraint days, with olive and white waiting for lighter rotations. The kind of tee modern urban fashion was supposed to be — quiet, considered, never reaching. 30-day returns at shopjono.com. Size up if you want extra slouch.

title: Shoreline Classic Tank — Sport Grey
description: For the days the city softens — sun on stone, a long walk that takes longer than it should, no destination required. Classic fit with clean armholes and a settled hem, easy to layer, easier to throw on alone. Sport grey carries the light well; white pairs with anything denim-adjacent. Belongs in the JONO Set summer rotation. 30-day returns at shopjono.com — pick your shade before the run thins.

title: Left Bank Relaxed Tee — Black
description: There's a way the light falls in a quiet quarter of Paris — soft, unhurried, slightly conspiratorial. This is the tee for that mood, exported. Relaxed fit through the body and shoulder; heavyweight cotton with a premium hand-feel that drapes without losing shape. Available across a soft palette — black, cornsilk, natural, sand, white — built to slot into rotations that lean tonal. Modern urban fashion that doesn't need to introduce itself. 30-day returns at shopjono.com.

title: Open Statement Tee — Black
description: A tee that speaks lowercase — present but never raised, the way the best graphic pieces work. Clean cut with a considered shape, true to size, with heavyweight cotton that sits cleanly across the shoulder. Comes in deep black for grounded fits, natural for warmer afternoons, and white when nothing else will do. One of the pieces the JONO Set wears when the day calls for a single decision and nothing more. 30-day returns at shopjono.com — pick the color that speaks first.

title: Coastline Evening Tee — Old Gold
description: Cut for the slow part of the evening — when the sun pulls low, the wind warms, and the day settles into its long ending. An easy, settled cut, true to size, in heavyweight cotton with a soft hand. Old gold carries the warmth of the moment; black, sand, and white hold their own once the light shifts. Sits high in the JONO Set summer-to-fall rotation. 30-day returns at shopjono.com — find your colorway before the run thins.

title: Skyline Classic Tee — Cherry Red
description: What the city sounds like at altitude — the soft drone of traffic, distant brake light, the kind of energy you can lean into without raising your voice. Classic fit with a clean line through the chest; heavyweight cotton with structured weight. Cherry red runs hot; cornsilk, dark heather, sand, and white hold the quieter end. Modern urban fashion built for the parts of the city that move without explaining themselves. 30-day returns at shopjono.com.

title: Studio Hours Oversized Tee — Black
description: Built for the hours when no one's watching and the work gets done — late, low light, a second cup, the right idea finally arriving. Slightly oversized fit with a clean shoulder and a hem that lands easy. Black for the focus; ice grey and natural for daylight transitions; tan and white for the lighter end. One of the JONO Set's quiet favorites — earned, never announced. 30-day returns at shopjono.com.

title: Sand Drift Tee — Sand Dune
description: Pulled from the calm end of the coast — the part where the houses are weathered, the salt's in the air, and the wind doesn't bother announcing itself. A clean retail fit, sits true to size, heavyweight cotton with a premium hand-feel. Available across a coastal palette — sand dune, vintage white, tan, autumn, and more — built to layer or stand alone. Modern urban fashion with the volume turned down. 30-day returns at shopjono.com.

title: Everyday Standard Hoodie — Heather Navy
description: The hoodie the rotation orbits around — warm, structured, built to take the season without complaint. Unisex fit with a clean drop through the shoulder and a hem that holds. Heather navy keeps things grounded; maroon, military green, ash, sand, and the rest cover the rest of the year. One of the few pieces the JONO Set buys in two colors. 30-day returns at shopjono.com — pick your weight before the cool months hit.

title: Late Hours Lightweight Tee
description: For the small hours and quieter cravings — the long walks home, the late conversations, the parts of the day that don't get photographed. Softly structured and lightweight, with a cut that wears closer to true. The widest palette in the collection — from grounded blacks and charcoals through the full color spectrum — built for anyone who likes a piece that fits the mood instead of the rule. Everyday premium at its most flexible. 30-day returns at shopjono.com.
